items.title: Open Strings & First Frets
items.credit: Original exercise by Riffway. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Original exercise written for Riffway; no third-party melody.

items.title: Ode to Joy
items.credit: Melody by Ludwig van Beethoven. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Beethoven died in 1827; the melody (Symphony No. 9, 1824) is in the public domain worldwide.

items.title: Power Chord Drive
items.credit: Original exercise by Riffway. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Original exercise written for Riffway; no third-party melody.

items.title: Greensleeves
items.credit: Traditional English melody. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Anonymous English tune from the 16th century (registered and printed in the 1580s); public domain worldwide.

items.title: Scarborough Fair
items.credit: Traditional English melody. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Traditional English ballad tune (Child Ballad 2); the folk melody is public domain. This arrangement is not based on any recorded or published arrangement.

items.title: Drop-D Palm-Mute Chug
items.credit: Original exercise by Riffway. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Original exercise written for Riffway; no third-party melody.

items.title: House of the Rising Sun
items.credit: Traditional American folk song. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Traditional American folk song of unknown authorship; the song is public domain. Only the commonly used chord progression is used, with picking patterns written for Riffway; no recorded arrangement is copied.

items.title: In the Hall of the Mountain King
items.credit: Melody by Edvard Grieg. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Grieg died in 1907; Peer Gynt (1875) is in the public domain worldwide.

items.title: Pentatonic Box Lick
items.credit: Original exercise by Riffway. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Original exercise written for Riffway; no third-party melody.

items.title: Alternate Picking Builder
items.credit: Original exercise by Riffway. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Original exercise written for Riffway; no third-party melody.

items.title: Carol of the Bells
items.credit: Melody by Mykola Leontovych (Shchedryk). Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Leontovych died in 1921 and Shchedryk was published in 1916, so the melody is public domain. The copyrighted 1936 English lyrics and choral arrangement are not used.

items.title: Für Elise (Theme)
items.credit: Melody by Ludwig van Beethoven. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Beethoven died in 1827; Für Elise (WoO 59, c. 1810) is in the public domain worldwide.

items.title: Spanish Romance
items.credit: Anonymous Spanish guitar piece. Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Anonymous Spanish guitar piece of the late 19th century (earliest sources around 1900); the composition is public domain. Later claims cover specific arrangements, none of which is used here.

items.title: Bourrée in E minor
items.credit: Music by Johann Sebastian Bach (BWV 996). Arrangement original to Riffway.
items.publicDomainNote: Bach died in 1750; the Suite in E minor BWV 996 is in the public domain worldwide.
